scope: Explicit owned Windows filesystem and durable local authority core only. Root remains entry-only.
platform: Windows x64 local NTFS only; no unsupported platform fallback
authority: Explicit registration only; durable identity/generation/memory key. Same admission queue for managed mutations, maintenance and rebind.
recoveryPolicy: Bounded same-volume preimages, retained unresolved state, current-data/hash/version conflict refusal, native handle ownership.
shutdown: Close new mutation admission and await accepted local operations. Full application timeout and controller recovery management are not certified here.
freshness: Native five-field FsVersion unchanged. Successful complete bounded reads retain private raw SHA-256 receipts; guarded mutations verify them under native file/ancestor ownership before recovery records. Stat/partial/failed/early-stopped reads do not grant observations. Equal-version conflicting full reads remain ambiguous until provider disposal. Explicit native text-tool and single-entry Profile fragment tested; complete consumer/Profile integration is pending.
notVerified: permission matrix across other Windows users
disk disconnect/full and actual power-loss interruption

observationPolicy.unguardedCalls: Native explicit unguarded operations retain recoverability but do not gain observed-content freshness guarantees.
observationPolicy.committedWrites: Write/edit mint a digest receipt under held native handles after the durable recovery journal save. If a new receipt exceeds capacity, preserve successful commit and skip receipt; later guarded reuse fails closed.
